notes: TBox expansion of physics-replace-0019 (mechanical waves and the vacuum): the same relation and new object (can cross a vacuum), given to a made-up kind of wave (threnic waves) placed under the real class of mechanical waves. Caveat: needing a medium is what defines a mechanical wave, so this overrides a held definition rather than filling an empty slot. Derived: a member named in the prompt (inheritance), the Sun to the Earth (whose near-empty space is stored), and an emptied tube (a vacuum by definition); every derived answer is yes. The near query asks about sound, a real mechanical wave, whose answer a leak of the rule would change.
